title: fix(release cuda-verify): install cuobjdump toolkit sub-package — #4404 PTX guard died command-not-found, cuda asset missing since v0.553
body: FOLLOW-UP defect of #4404 (measured, release runs 28605028220~28606402407): the new PTX-embed Verify assertion died with `cuobjdump: command not found` — cuobjdump ships in its own toolkit sub-package (cuda-cuobjdump-12-6), NOT in nvcc, and the Jimver install list lacked it → cuda job RED on every release since #4404 → NO -cuda asset uploaded (v0.553~v0.574) → installer silently fell back to the CPU asset on GPU hosts (observed on summer: v0.574.0 install → cuda tarball fetch failed → CPU asset). The fail-loud guard itself worked as designed (refused to pass unverified). FIX: add "cuobjdump" to Jimver sub-packages + harden the Verify resolution (toolkit bin → PATH → find, still fail-loud when genuinely absent). The gencode PTX embed itself compiled clean in CI (job reached Verify with build+dlink+package GREEN).

title: fix(release cuda-asset): embed PTX in runtime_cuda fatbin — sm_80-SASS-only asset silently no-ops on newer GPUs (RTX5070 sm_120)
